limitations: Adjacent windows of one public meeting, not independent meetings or in-house4speaker/gallery50 acceptance.
Live uses actual emitted assignments; finalizedLive5s is explicitly labelled a retrospective comparison control.
Legacy segments and secondary standard only-words protocols remain separate; holdout only-words contains3lexical speakers.
Unknown/uncertain/provisional turns do not gain invented RTTM identities; missed reference speech remains scored.
Sampled CPU/RSS and warm-cache possible constructor times are observations, not peak/sustained hardware qualifications.
Unpaced direct-core throughput is not GUI/live capture latency; no devices,network,private meetings,ASR or app activation.

manifest.acquisition: User explicitly requested official release downloads and acknowledged the source notice. Original pyannote Hugging Face acquisition requires its own publisher conditions; this app neither logs in nor accepts them. No weights are bundled with the application.
manifest.attribution: pyannote/Séverin Baroudi, Alexis Plaquet and Hervé Bredin; CNRS. 3D-Speaker/ModelScope ERes2Net; sherpa-onnx conversion by k2-fsa. Source model revisions are not provided by release assets. ERes2Net source model language is Chinese; English/channel calibration is unvalidated.
manifest.calibration: experimental_uncalibrated; assign=0.55 merge=0.70 margin=0.10; NOT identification confidence

full_artifacts.source_rechecks: All supplied config/corpus/reference/prior-artifact/control and model file hashes rechecked before successful publication

metric_protocol.speaker_mapping: global maximum co-occurrence duration (Hungarian); JER uses the same duration-optimal mapping
metric_protocol.references: Original derived NXT transcriber-segment protocol and separately labelled standard only-words protocol; both preserved; no new references or timestamps synthesized

matched_comparison.before: Actual production Phase::Live final result, explicitly retrospective and distinct from emittedLive labels;5s source context
matched_comparison.after: Actual production Phase::Refined final result;10s real source context
matched_comparison.prior_projection_comparison: Every SpeakerTurn JSON field except provenance is exactly compared, including id/track/start/end/speaker_ids/label/score/overlap/uncertain/provisional. Only provenance phase strings live-cluster vs refined-cluster are ignored. All four comparisons returned true.

policy_source_audit.finalize_rs_changes: Only phase-dependent context warning and additive segmentation_context metadata; clustering/constraint/Unknown policy unchanged

matched_comparison.constraints_and_prior: No pair/temporal constraints and no reference speaker-count prior for any phase
matched_comparison.raw_input: Same pinned PCM16 WAV decoded to normalized floats; gain1; no resampling/gain/source modification at runner; Mic/in-person production API,20ms packets

fragmentation_interpretation: Refined19/13 all assigned IDs include provisional/uncertain identities; only6/3 survive masking into scored RTTM. Neither count establishes correct participant identification; legacy has4 speakers and holdout only-words3 lexical speakers.
